intent: vendor preset "Blowing Seeds Wide" (Nature) — validate against its thumbnail

iterations.critique: The render has the right botanical/dandelion-like source imagery on black, but it reads as a field of intact dandelion heads with stems rather than loose seeds blowing outward. At t1 the frame is very sparse; by t4 it abruptly becomes crowded with large, upright full flowers distributed across the entire image. The temporal change is primarily accumulation/population, not a coherent wind-driven plume or wide dispersal from a seed source. The near-comp-sized emitter makes particles appear everywhere instead of traveling outward from a localized origin.

The sprite imagery now reads as individual dandelion seeds rather than intact flower heads, which is closer to the intended botanical look. However, both frames still show seeds born across a broad, nearly full-comp band. From t1 to t4 the dominant change is a denser random field, not a clearly wind-driven dispersal plume emerging from one source and traveling wide. The visible long seed stems also make the drift feel mostly upright/static rather than carried laterally by air.

This is now clearly a localized release of dandelion seeds that expands into a broad rightward plume: t1 has a compact source cluster and t4 shows the same material dispersed widely across the right half of the frame. That is a substantial match to the intended blowing-seeds motion, and it avoids the prior full-frame birth field. The result remains somewhat too sparse and faint, however; the t4 plume has large empty gaps and lacks the fuller, more visually legible seed cloud expected from a preset thumbnail.
